scenario: SauceDemo inventory → detail 状态错位
prompt: Open saucedemo.com, login with standard_user / secret_sauce, click the first product add to cart button, then verify the cart page shows the product

current_behavior.pattern: inventory state → 点击商品名 → detail state → 下一步仍引用 inventory state 的 add-to-cart ref
current_behavior.failure: 目标 ref 属于 S0，执行时处于 S1（detail）——同一 pattern 曾导致 add-to-cart 定位失败/错误

metrics.false_resolution: 必须为零（不得因 fuzzy 或 business dedup 误命中等错误成功）
